title: His Front Door Made Him Rich
description:
Marlo locked himself out at midnight. The locksmith took three hours and charged him $200.

Watch how one locked door turned into a million-dollar idea, the night 400 keys crashed to the floor, and why MegaSock's smart locks couldn't compete.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).
